Subject: Mutual Action Plan: BlueCrest GCP private offer — evaluation & billing runway

Hi Elisa —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our conversation I put together a short mutual action plan (MAP) to get BlueCrest onto Redwood via a GCP private offer. High level: we want a 4-week eval window, technical acceptance gates at week 2 and week 4, and a billing/onboarding runway that ties the private-offer activation to your PO.

Key asks for BlueCrest:
- Confirm procurement contact and PO timeline (we recommend PO by 2029-06-10)
- Share any required legal redlines for the GCP private-offer T&Cs by 2029-05-24
- Provide the initial eval cluster sizing: expected concurrent QPS and token/day

Redwood commitments:
- Provide a scoped eval environment (dedicated pool) and support during acceptance gates
- SOC2 evidence snapshot attached; we can provide more narrow evidence to procurement as needed
- Activate GCP private offer once PO is received and terms are agreed

I've attached a draft MAP (BlueCrest_MAP_v1.xlsx) and the GCP private-offer template (GCP_Private_Offer_Terms_v2.pdf). If the timeline looks good, we'll schedule a 30-min kickoff next Tue (2029-05-21) to lock milestones.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 20 May 2029 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: BlueCrest MAP — invoice routing and discount cadence

Team — quick notes after reviewing Elisa's procurement timeline:

1) Invoice & billing path
- GCP private-offer activation requires mapping the committed SKUs to the marketplace listing. We'll need BlueCrest's billing account ID to link the private offer to their GCP billing.
- Preferred flow: Redwoods issues a consolidated invoice monthly to BlueCrest AP; Finance (Jordan) to confirm net terms.

2) Credit/discount handling during eval
- For a 4-week eval we usually offer an evaluation credit up to $10k that can be applied to the first invoice if they convert within 30 days of acceptance. This should be captured in the MAP and in the private-offer notes.

3) Legal redlines
- If BlueCrest procurement returns the private-offer T&Cs with redlines, loop in Legal early — Naomi, can you coordinate a 24-48h turnaround for standard marketplace redline review?

Next steps: I propose we confirm (a) BlueCrest billing account ID, (b) PO ETA (Elisa suggested 2029-06-12), and (c) finalize MAP with credit terms. I'll hold off on approvals until Jordan confirms the billing recipient.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
